node.title: Re^4: Joining multiple lines together while parsing
node.author: Arengin
node.doctext:
The input is always like: Dumpdata example ----------------- Warning Detail: Info: Spec: Dumpdata example ----------------- Warning Detail: Info: Dumpdata example ----------------- Warning Detail: Spec: Dumpdata example ----------------- Warning Detail: Info: Spec:
The "Dumpdata example" always starts a new section even if not all elements were present.
